# Txio

> Txio is one console for every chain: build, simulate, sign and run blockchain RPC calls and transactions on Sui, Ethereum and other EVM chains, Solana, Aptos and Stellar (Soroban). It ships as a web app, a desktop app and a CLI, with one account across all three. Txio is pre-1.0 and has not had a security audit.

Txio understands chain-specific RPC methods, transaction formats and address shapes. It is not a generic HTTP client. Each chain has a native dry run before signing, and wallet signing (including Ledger) happens in the user's own wallet. Mainnet actions show an explicit warning first.

## Product pages

- [Home](https://txio.xyz/): overview, FAQ, and how the three surfaces fit together
- [Features](https://txio.xyz/features): method autocomplete, parameter templates, per-chain transaction builders, cURL import, endpoint failover
- [Supported chains](https://txio.xyz/ecosystem): Sui, Ethereum and EVM mainnets, Solana, Aptos, Stellar with Soroban
- [Infrastructure](https://txio.xyz/infrastructure): RPC endpoint failover, latency checks, private RPC URLs, shared core across surfaces
- [Integrations](https://txio.xyz/integrations): what works on each chain today, with known gaps listed
- [Partners](https://txio.xyz/partners): swap, bridge, wallet, history and RPC providers
- [Docs](https://txio.xyz/docs): the Txio CLI, the public execution API, running the stack locally with Docker
- [Download](https://txio.xyz/download): the desktop app for Linux, macOS and Windows
